body:
TASK-1752 PR: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2763, head a8684094ba (2 commits behind main; does not touch the same files). Behavior unchanged.

Moved sites:
- seat_authority.rs: NEW current_grant_id() returns the raw non-blank handle, UNVALIDATED (grant_check still decides authority)
- queue_cmd.rs:13216 standalone-reviewer launcher_grant: env::var(...).filter(non-blank) -> current_grant_id()
- queue_cmd.rs headless_baseline_notice: literal -> {grant_env}=GRANT_ENV, identical text
- queue_cmd.rs:10803 doc comment: literal -> GRANT_ENV link
- session.rs:3712 doc comment: literal -> GRANT_ENV link
- session_misc.rs:598 current-session fallback: env::var(...).ok() -> current_grant_id() (blank was already dropped by the later trim filter). NOT in the brief's 5 modules, but it was a direct read. The :589 /proc environ lookup of ANOTHER pid stays as is
- role_cmd.rs (persona enter, role enter export/unset, role end unset): literal -> format with GRANT_ENV, byte-identical eval output
- agent_launch.rs bg and exec child: .env_remove("AIDA_SESSION_GRANT") -> .env_remove(seat_authority::GRANT_ENV)
- role_cmd_args.rs: clap help text for `aida role expiry` kept verbatim (user-facing). It is the guard's ONE exemption, matched by exact line

Guard: src/tests/task_1752_grant_env_guard_tests.rs bans the literal and any env::var read of the grant outside seat_authority.rs, across all crates. It skips tests/ dirs and inline #[cfg(test)] mod blocks anywhere in a file, and fails if a block never closes. Mutation-checked.

Gates passed: check-ci-fast (32), check-ci-compile, test-touched (847), the lib filters for touched modules, and the bug_2139/queue_work_dry_run/task_1736 integration tests.
subject: TASK-1752 ready for STRICT review: PR-2763 @ a8684094ba
